processReview.independenceWarning: These are revisions of one evolving BRO positive-kill-handicap thesis, not five independent betting wins.
processReview.falseNegativeFinding: The model rejected every quoted BRO positive line even though BRO retained or restored strong Gnar and Yunara item states, structural compensation, and return-kill capacity.
processReview.itemValuationFinding: The model initially underweighted Gnar and Yunara as item-qualified stabilization channels and overemphasized Annie's weakness as if BRO's return-kill production depended on Annie alone.
processReview.repairGateFinding: The strict two-conversion re-entry rule prevented recognition of materially improved fundamentals. This map should be included in the v0.3.19 review sample as a potential over-veto case.
processReview.lineChasingFinding: The result does not prove that wider lines should automatically be chased. It shows that the anti-line-chasing veto may be too rigid when item-qualified carries, tower parity, gold parity, and objective compensation materially improve after the initial warning.
processReview.recommendedFutureReview: Do not change the active model from this single map. At the scheduled v0.3.19 review, test whether a documented item-and-structure repair pathway should allow a watch lean before two full structured-fight conversions.
processReview.terminologyCorrection: The user described all BRO positive leans as winners. In the model log, these were NO BET or vetoed shadow lines, not official bets and mostly not formal leans.
